title: DONKEY.BAS — IBM PC (1981)
excerpt: Play DONKEY.BAS in your browser — the classic IBM PC game by Bill Gates and Neil Konzen, for the 45th anniversary of the IBM PC.
content_html:
Space / tap — switch lanes Esc — title

About

DONKEY.BAS shipped with early IBM PC DOS as a demo of color graphics and sound in BASICA. It was written by Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates and Neil Konzen in 1981 (version 1.10 in 1982). You only switch lanes — avoid the donkey, or BOOM.

This page recreates the original CGA gameplay in JavaScript with some liberties. Original source: DONKEY.BAS · GitHub

About

DONKEY.BAS 随早期 IBM PC DOS 一起提供，作为 BASICA 中彩色图形和声音的演示。 它由微软联合创始人比尔·盖茨和尼尔·康岑于 1981 年编写（1982 年版本 1.10）。 你只需变换车道——避开驴子，或者轰隆隆。

此页面在 JavaScript 中重新创建了原始的 CGA 游戏玩法，但有一些自由。 原始来源：DONKEY.BAS·GitHub
